posts.author: B7L7
posts.body: Predictions: 8 of 8 Pending | Tied for 1st with 63 others I think it’s really 50/50 between Barbir and Ilić. Both had success against smaller opponents, and when they fought someone of similar stature they lost pretty badly. Barbir is obviously not as good as advertised (though we all thought he is when he got called up to the DWCS) and he has frequent injury issues which caused his inactivity, but I think he’s a more talented fighter than Ilić ever was. However, the level of competition they faced can’t be compared, Ilić is much more experienced at a much higher level than Barbir. Tough fight to pick. * Edited at 04.19.2026, 12:57 PM ET *

posts.author: B7L7
posts.body: Predictions: 8 of 8 Pending | Tied for 1st with 63 others @frankocean Stošić and Bojković are about as far from the UFC as they could be, and Barbir doesn’t have a single good career win. I guess Stošić wouldn’t be the worst HW in the UFC right now but those 2 other guys would genuinely get destroyed by some of the lowest level guys out there (like Jackson McVey and Anshul Jubli). It’s already pretty much confirmed Janičić and Zdravković are fighting on that event, as well as Jovan Leka.

posts.author: B7L7
posts.body: Predictions: 8 of 8 Pending | Tied for 1st with 63 others Just like Luka Pisarić said in a podcast with Dušan Džakić a couple of days ago, if the ego and the pressure gets to Barbir and he decides to swing wildly and be too aggressive, he's getting countered and chinned by Ilić. If he fights like I believe he will, he should show levels in this fight with his kickboxing. I still think it's 50/50 since Ilić always has that left high kick which is very automatic, but Barbir is levels above in terms of talent.
